definition: FlowerChecker, also known as Kindwise, is a company that uses machine learning to identify natural objects from images.
details: This includes plants and their diseases, but also insects and mushrooms. It is based in Brno, Czech Republic. It was founded in 2014 by Ondřej Veselý, Jiří Řihák, and Ondřej Vild, at the time Ph.D. students.
